versions.changelog:
- Initial release of short-drama-skill-finder.
- Recommends AI short drama, micro drama, and manju (漫剧) skills from a curated list of 90+ projects.
- Matches skill suggestions to production stage, video model, and agent based on user needs.
- Supports both English and Chinese, including specialized drama creation workflows.
- Provides key details for each recommended skill, including install instructions, supported agents, and license info.
